patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width hero-style presentations and structured two-column layouts, often with a prominent image or illustration on one side and text on the other.
The site uses a clear typographic hierarchy with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for impact and smaller, readable sans-serif text for body content and descriptions.

A high-contrast palette of stark white backgrounds and black text is consistently accented by a vibrant, warm orange/yellow (seen in illustrations and the footer gradient) and a professional deep blue for links and interactive elements.

As the user scrolls, the hero section's large text and neuron illustration move upwards, with the neuron appearing to parallax slightly. Subsequent content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. A sticky header remains at the top, and a right-side pagination indicator highlights the current section.
Process steps are presented as a numbered vertical list, where each step's title is large and bold, followed by a concise description, creating a clear, scannable flow.

technique_notes: The scroll-triggered animations, including the hero parallax, section reveals, and sticky header, are orchestrated using a JavaScript animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger. Elements are set to animate their position or opacity as they enter or exit the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.

The hero section combines a large, impactful heading with a detailed, organic illustration (neuron) that is positioned to create depth and visual interest, moving independently from the text during scroll to enhance the parallax effect.
Interactive elements like buttons and accordion FAQs feature subtle hover states, typically involving a background color change or a slight scale transformation, providing clear visual feedback.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual anchors, complemented by clear, regular-weight sans-serif body text for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp for most structural components, maintaining a clean and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with the sophisticated integration of a complex, organic illustration (the neuron) into its hero section, which then dynamically parallaxes with scroll. The combination of a clean, almost clinical aesthetic with these vibrant, illustrative elements and a striking orange gradient footer creates a unique and memorable brand identity that feels both professional and visually engaging.
